messages:
maria.perez: Heads-up — I'm drafting an RFC for private deployments (VPC + on‑prem) around customer-managed networking. Need to lock scope & launch criteria by EOW. High-level ask: agreement on required features vs post-launch ops. Thoughts?

alex.kim: +1. Can we start with acceptance criteria draft? I think minimum viable: 1) network isolation (non-overlapping CIDRs); 2) secure control plane connectivity; 3) egress policy controls; 4) rollback path.

kevin-ops: Add: BGP peering templates, MTU negotiation guidance, DNS forwarding, and NAT handling. Also need explicit plan for overlapping customer CIDRs (NAT64 or transit gateways). Edge case: asymmetric routing for multi-AZ on-prem setups.

jess_prod: For roadmap prioritization — customers are asking for: private KMS integration, audit logs shipped to customer SIEM, and per-tenant routing policies. Which of these are must-have for GA?

maria.perez: My proposal: GA = isolation + control plane + audit logs + basic egress. KMS + per-tenant routing = GA+1. Customers can opt-in to early access.

alex.kim: Acceptance criteria in pseudo:
```
- Control plane: TLS mutual auth + RBAC
- Data plane: no default internet egress unless configured
- Audit: events delivered to customer S3/Kafka (>= 7 days)
- Rollout: can toggle between managed and customer egress per tenancy
```
Need SLO targets for DNS/e2e connectivity.

kevin-ops: Edge cases list:
- Overlapping CIDRs -> require explicit customer NAT or use of proxy; document workaround.
- Customer firewall blocking control plane -> offline install docs + heartbeat checks.
- Heavy egress -> recommend burst capacity config and rate limiting.
- MTU < 1500 -> path MTU negotiation.

infra-bot: Note: current private control plane deploys on k8s 1.26 with calico. Calico doesn't support built-in BGP with cloud providers — we'll need a design note.

jess_prod: UX question: Do we expose "egress mode" in Console (managed vs customer)? Customers want a toggle in UI + API. Also need clear pricing implications.

maria.perez: Action items:
- @alex.kim: draft acceptance criteria doc (PRD section) by Tue.
- @kevin-ops: enumerate edge cases + short remediation playbook.
- @jess_prod: capture customer asks + prioritize for GA vs GA+1.
- I'll consolidate into RFC and schedule review Thurs.

alex.kim: sounds good. I'll add small config schema example:
```
egress:
  mode: customer | managed
  customer_vpn: { cidr: "10.0.0.0/16", bgp: true }
  snat: true
```

kevin-ops: quick Q — do we require customers to terminate VPN/Direct Connect, or do we offer a managed transit? This affects SLA.

maria.perez: We should offer both but GA only documents customer-terminated options; managed transit is a paid add-on later.

jess_prod: Ok — timeline looks doable. I'll draft customer communication noting constraints and known limitations.

alex.kim: PRD link when ready pls. tagging security review: @security-team for KMS/audit requirements.

maria.perez: thanks all. RFC review slot Thurs 10am. :thumbsup:
